[B1] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendMessage' UserX | (encrypt(FreshR,Key)) .
[B1] < UserX | 'message' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendMessage' UserX | (Message)
=> < UserX | 'message' : Message , ... > .
[B1] < UserX | 'message' : StoredMessage , ... > $ deviceB 'sendMessage' UserX | (Message)
=> < UserX | 'message' : StoredMessage , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'message' : encrypt(R,Key) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; encrypt(R,Key))
=> < UserX | 'message' : encrypt(R,Key) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'message' : encrypt(R,Key) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX,Owners) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; encrypt(R,Key))
=> < UserX | 'message' : encrypt(R,Key) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX,Owners) , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < UserX | ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : nils , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
